forbidden.name: not-to-node-builtins
forbidden.comment: Plugin code runs inside the opencode host (node), but accidental node builtin imports in shared libs should stay explicit.

forbidden.name: no-orphans
forbidden.comment: Extends recommended-strict's no-orphans. Entry modules wired by their consumer instead of a src import are excepted: the MCP workspace resolver is consumed by the (separately built) stdio entry. The replaced base from.pathNot only filtered dotfiles/configs, of which none live under src/.
